method: Read existing source code and checked-in JSON; evaluate app functions in memory. No external collection, credentials access, or source-data modification. Only this evidence file is written.

reproduction: Load the named tax record and source-status JSON.
Evaluate docs/app.js with document stubs, populate state.sourceStatus from statuses.
Call freshnessStatusForItem(record) and freshnessLabel(...). The unmodified full record says current / 출처 점검 완료 although the linked source is stale.
Call the same function with {...record, source_ids: record.sources}; the result becomes stale. No date-dependent assumption is needed because source freshness is explicitly stale.
findings.expected: Use the same linked source identifiers for full records and compact records. Do not display completion by bypassing an explicit stale source state.

reproduction: Use the API collection link generated by renderApiCollectionLink(local-government-supports).
api-data.js filters the inventory by reference_published, so the requested government-service dataset is absent from entries.
findIndex returns -1; no selection/error is set, and load() loads the first option: 한국은행 기준금리 / StatisticSearch.
The target JSON exists and contains 10,947 items, but the link shows unrelated 46-row interest-rate statistics.
findings.expected: A provided source/operation link must select that dataset or display an explicit unavailable-dataset state; it must not silently display another source.
findings.policy_review_separate: Eleven inventory entries omit reference_published. Whether to expose those entries is a separate publication-policy decision. The confirmed defect is silent fallback from an existing provided link, not the exclusion alone.
